rows.provenance_note: Native Greek example with no English source. The complete before and after records are identical and match the actual training pair. Independently checking the arithmetic gives 23:10 − 19:35 = 215 minutes and 215 − 25 = 190 minutes = 3 hours 10 minutes.

The Greek problem preserves the English teaching objective and numerical premises. Independently checking the solution gives the original slope 6/−9 = −2/3 and perpendicular slope −1/(−2/3) = 3/2. The editor changed only the description of the negative reciprocal, making it more idiomatic and mathematically explicit without altering the reasoning.
